evidence.quote: In general, each word has only one meaning and is approved with only one part of speech.

evidence.quote: Instead of writing, ask your LLM to create a diagram. These can be a lot easier to process, parse, and understand.

text: STEMG 는 STE 가 일반 글쓰기용이 아니라고 하면서, 짧은 문장, 문장마다 주제 하나, 능동태 같은 원칙은 다른 글에도 쓸 수 있다고 덧붙인다

evidence.quote: It is not intended for general-purpose writing, such as international correspondence. However, many of its principles (for example, short sentences, one topic per sentence, and the use of the active voice) can be effectively adopted and applied in other writing contexts.

evidence.quote: if there is a condition in a work step that readers must know before doing the work step, it is important to put this condition at the beginning of the sentence.

text: 영어 동의어 가운데 하나만 쓴다 (begin, commence 대신 start)

evidence.quote: When there are synonyms in English, STE selects one synonym and does not include the others. For example, STE uses start instead of begin , commence , initiate , or originate .

text: -ing 형은 품사가 모호해서 대부분 쓰지 않는다

evidence.quote: These different functions for words that have an “-ing” form can frequently cause ambiguity or long, complex sentences. Thus, words that have an “-ing” form are usually not permitted.

text: FAQ 는 STE 가 읽는 사람을 위한 것이지 쓰기 쉬운 것은 아니라고 말하고, 쓰는 사람에게 CEFR C1 수준의 영어를 권한다

evidence.quote: STE was created for the maximum benefit of the reader. This does not necessarily mean that it is simple to write.

evidence.quote: Many readers have only limited knowledge of English and may be easily confused by complex sentence structures, as well as by the large number of meanings and synonyms that many English words have.

text: STEMG 는 AI 가 쓴 글이 규칙과 어휘를 제대로 지키지 않아도 STE 처럼 보일 수 있다고 경고한다

evidence.quote: AI-generated text can appear clear, authoritative, and consistent with STE, even when it does not correctly apply the rules and vocabulary of the standard. Plausibility must not be confused with verified compliance.

evidence.locator: §Will STE change the meaning of technical texts?
